player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I repeated the name "Layton" four times, which uses the letter "a" four times, violating the constraint of using it at most once. Next time, I will compose a short, original verse that describes Layton's themes (like puzzles, logic, or the Professor) using only one instance of the letter "a" in the entire song, ensuring every other word is carefully selected to avoid "a", "an", "and", "the", "is", "are", etc., or by using synonyms that do not contain the letter.
